meta.name: Fading Grandeur
meta.description: Desperate to sell his crumbling mansion, a fallen marquis tries to make a quick deal with a charming yet mysterious millionaire who has her own agenda.

videos.title: The Marquis
videos.overview: With no money to pay for his daughter's wedding, marquis Leandro puts his mansion up for sale — and businesswoman Sofía could be the buyer he needs.

videos.title: Conchi
videos.overview: Leandro aims to impress with a visit to a country club, but his attempt to save face costs him dearly. Sofía's responsibilities catch up with her.

videos.title: Mediterranean Drifts
videos.overview: As Sofía makes a risky move with her finances and Leandro hides from his bills, they take a trip to Málaga — which threatens to unravel the entire plan.

videos.title: Outskirts
videos.overview: Leandro's suspicions lead him to spy on Sofía far from home. Meanwhile, his daughter Martina's cold feet threaten to trample his future nobility.

videos.title: The Funeral
videos.overview: An unwelcome face from her past threatens to ruin everything for Sofía. Leandro asks his father for power of attorney, and presses a little too hard.

videos.title: Who Is Sofía Carrington
videos.overview: The police arrive at the mansion. At Martina's wedding, Leandro aims to end the rivalry with his brother, and Sofía wonders what she really wants.
